cues: Collision theory pictures a reaction as the result of collisions.
In a gas at room temperature there are about ten to the thirty collisions per litre every second.
If every one worked, every gas reaction would be over in a microsecond.
text: Collision theory pictures a reaction as the result of collisions. First, molecules must collide. In a gas at room temperature there are about ten to the thirty collisions per litre every second. If every one worked, every gas reaction would be over in a microsecond.
